Description: Reads your Doman Mahjong hand and either suggests the best discard or plays the match for you.
Changelog: v0.1.3.2: Tsumo button now actually clicks. v0.1.3.x shipped a regression where ComputeAcceptIndex never advanced its slot past Riichi on a Tsumo offer, so the click landed one button early 鈥?usually on Pass (Tsumo alone) or on Ron (Ron+Tsumo). On a localized client with 鑷懜/鍜岀墝 visible this showed up as the bot silently passing on a winning hand and the 8-second timer expiring. The accept index now advances past every offered action, matching ComputePassIndex's button count, and a new battery of index tests pins the Tsumo position under every combo. Also keeps v0.1.3.1's Chinese/Japanese call-prompt label fix live at state-6/28.
